cavitationReactors.name: High-Frequency Rotary Rotor-Stator Cavitation Reactor (ShockWave Power Reactor - SPR, 3,600 RPM)
cavitationReactors.classification: Industrial Rotary Hydrodynamic Cavitation Skid (3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05 / EHEDG Class 1)
cavitationReactors.sanitaryCertifications: 3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05, EHEDG Class 1 Aseptic, ASME B31.3, CE Machinery
cavitationReactors.description: High-speed spinning rotor equipped with hundreds of surface indentations generating controlled high-frequency micro-cavitation vortex clouds. Shockwaves collapse away from chamber walls directly in fluid stream, preventing metal erosion while delivering extreme sonochemical and mechanical shear.

cavitationReactors.name: Multi-Orifice High-Velocity Venturi Plate Cavitation Block (Tungsten Carbide Inserts, 20-80 bar)
cavitationReactors.classification: In-Line Continuous Constricted-Flow Cavitator (ASME B31.3 / FDA 21 CFR § 117 cGMP)
cavitationReactors.sanitaryCertifications: ASME B31.3 High Pressure Sanitary, 3-A Sanitary 04-05, FDA cGMP Food Contact
cavitationReactors.description: In-line hydrodynamic cavitation block featuring 12 precision-machined micro-orifices (1.8 mm dia) producing extreme fluid acceleration (>85 m/s) and severe static pressure drop below fluid vapor pressure, followed by rapid pressure recovery and intense cloud collapse.

cavitationReactors.name: Helical Swirl Chamber & Acoustic Whistle Cavitator (Hydrodynamic Acoustic Resonance, 28.5 kHz)
cavitationReactors.classification: Acousto-Hydrodynamic Hybrid Flow Cavitator (EHEDG Sanitary Dairy / Beverage)
cavitationReactors.sanitaryCertifications: 3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05, EHEDG Doc 8 & 17, USDA Dairy Accepted
cavitationReactors.description: Tangential swirl injection nozzle combined with an internal acoustic reed resonator blade. Induces dual vortex cavitation and 28.5 kHz acoustic pressure fluctuations for enhanced lipid globule disruption and gentle low-temperature pasteurization.

cavitationReactors.name: Severely Eroded / Pitted Throttle Valve Cavitation Unit (Cavitation Pitting, Flow Choking)
cavitationReactors.classification: HAZARDOUS / DEGRADED (ASTM G32 Cavitation Erosion Damage / Metal Particulate Contamination)
cavitationReactors.sanitaryCertifications: NON-COMPLIANT (Erosion Pits Harboring Biofilms / Severe Metal Particulate Shedding)
cavitationReactors.description: Severely compromised constricted-flow cavitator operating with uncontrolled asymmetric bubble collapse against internal walls. Suffers from deep cavitation pits (>200 µm), metal alloy erosion, hydraulic vapor choking, and failure to achieve pathogen lethality.

fluidMedia.name: Dairy Whole Milk & Whey Protein Concentrate (WPC-80) Stream (Density 1.032 g/cm³, Viscosity 2.8 cP)
fluidMedia.description: Raw or standardized dairy milk stream. CHC reduces milk fat globule clusters to sub-micron diameters without thermal fouling of pasteurizer plates or denaturation of heat-sensitive immunoglobulins and lactoferrin.

fluidMedia.name: Cold-Pressed Raw Orange & Lemon Juice (Brix 11.5°, pH 3.4, Pectin Methylesterase Active)
fluidMedia.productClass: Acidic Cold-Pressed Fruit Juice & Bioactive Polyphenols
fluidMedia.description: Fresh cold-pressed citrus juice with high ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) content. Hydrodynamic cavitation inactivates spoilage yeasts and pectin methylesterase (PME) cloud-separating enzyme without cooked off-flavors.

fluidMedia.name: Plant-Based Oat & Almond Barista Milk Emulsion (3.5% Lipids, Beta-Glucan, Viscosity 6.5 cP)
fluidMedia.description: Plant milk emulsion requiring superior colloidal emulsion stability and barista foaming performance. Extreme hydrodynamic shear shatters insoluble cellular fibers and encapsulates lipids into uniform sub-200 nm droplets.

fluidMedia.name: Concentrated Tomato Pulp & Puree (Brix 12.0°, Viscosity 185 cP, Intracellular Lycopene)
fluidMedia.description: High-solids shear-thinning tomato dispersion. Cavitational micro-jets shear tomato cell walls, liberating intracellular water-soluble pectins and lycopene chromophores, dramatically increasing Bostwick serum viscosity.

targetPathogens.name: Listeria monocytogenes (Scott A, Gram-Positive Psychrotrophic Foodborne Pathogen)
targetPathogens.description: Tough peptidoglycan cell wall (20-30 nm thickness) provides elevated structural resistance to pressure waves. Requires combined sonochemical membrane peroxidation and direct micro-jet mechanical impingement.

targetPathogens.name: Escherichia coli O157:H7 (Enterohemorrhagic Shiga Toxin Producer, Gram-Negative Outer Membrane)
targetPathogens.description: Outer lipopolysaccharide (LPS) membrane is rapidly compromised by cavitational hydroxyl radicals (•OH) and localized high shear stress, causing rapid intracellular cytoplasmic leakage.

targetPathogens.name: Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium (Acid-Adapted Enteric Pathogen)
targetPathogens.description: Critical biological target under FDA FSMA and Juice HACCP regulations. High susceptibility to hydrodynamic shockwaves and sonochemical oxidative cell membrane cleavage.

targetPathogens.name: Saccharomyces cerevisiae & Spoilage Yeast (Eukaryotic Cell Wall, Glucan-Mannan Matrix)
targetPathogens.description: Relatively large cell diameter (5-8 µm) creates high mechanical drag in cavitational shear fields, making yeast highly susceptible to localized acoustic and hydrodynamic tearing.
